# git: alias: add fixup command

Add a `git fixup` alias around `git commit --fixup=<commit>` + `git rebase -i --autosquash`, the workflow of [Jordan Elver's article](https://jordanelver.co.uk/blog/2020/06/04/fixing-commits-with-git-commit-fixup-and-git-rebase-autosquash/), and consider [git-absorb](https://github.com/tummychow/git-absorb), which picks the target commit for each staged hunk automatically. **Motivation:** developer experience — folding a correction into an earlier commit without manual interactive rebasing.
